QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #10
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Mu Lung's brilliant instructor No Gong seemed to have ruined his training uniform, and asked us to make a new one for him.\n\n#i4001183# #t4001183# #b#c4001183# / 30
QuestInfo.2: This time, Keol asked me to create a brand new training uniform for Instructor No Gong of Mu Lung. First off, red belt!!

1.0: How unexpected. Out of everyone, you're the first to have them ready. You've gotten much faster than when you first started. This doesn't mean the items are flawed, right? I honestly didn't think you'd be able to finish this.

item.0: Was this too much for you... it was just #b30 #t4001183#s#k...

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.

0.0: What are you doing just standing there? If you're here, come closer. We just received an order from Mu Lung. Apparently, Maple Admin went there and talked about our work. This time, we have to work on the uniforms, and... it's a huge order. I have no idea what they are going to do with this many uniforms. Anyway, we'll have to split this workload, and... are you in?

yes.0: You will be responsible for #b30 #t4001183#s#k. What are you doing just standing there looking dazed and confused? There's no time for that. Time is ticking. Tick tock tick tock. Can't you see Moren and Ramain working hard right now?

no.0: Moren seemed to be counting on you for help... how am I going to break this #bDISAPPOINTING#k news to him?
